# Himanshu Singh — Electrical Engineering Researcher

> Personal academic website: https://himanshu3122.github.io/

Himanshu Singh is a B.Tech. Electrical Engineering student at the Institute of Engineering & Management (IEM), Kolkata, India. His research models the electrical power demand of cloud and AI data centers, using stochastic workload and traffic models, component-level load models, and power-system simulation to study energy efficiency and grid stability.
